title: UAAP: Adamson fends off FEU, rises to solo third in women's hoops
summary: Adamson University survived a late scare from Far Eastern University, 79-75, to claim solo third place in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament on Wednesday at the Araneta Coliseum.
